text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — onboarding Nimbus Labs next week. Need a concise cross-cloud provisioning checklist (AWS + GCP + Azure). Focus: GPU instance quotas, VPC/VPN setup, org tags, billing export, and any region constraints. Who's picking this up?

Sandeep: I can drive. started a high-level checklist below, will turn into a ticket with owners.

Maria: +1, happy to help with GCP pieces (IAM + billing export). Any special compliance needs?

Alex: They want data isolated per team (non-shared projects) and central billing. No extra compliance beyond SOC2 baseline. Also prefer us to reserve capacity in us-west2 / us-east-1 for predictability.

Kai: Important callout: Azure GPUs (ND series) are quota-per-subscription and region-limited. If we need consistent availability we should request quota increases *and* a capacity reservation where possible.

Sandeep: Draft checklist (short):
- Create org structure: org -> billing account -> folders per environment -> projects/subscriptions per team
- Enforce tagging policy: environment, cost_center, owner, data_classification
- IAM: org-level roles + infra service accounts. Grant SA impersonation for deployment pipelines
- Networking: Shared VPC vs per-project? We recommend Shared VPC with delegated admin for infra team.
- NAT & egress: define static egress ranges + firewall rules, list IP allowlist for partner integrations
- GPU quotas: open support tickets for us-west2/us-east-1 (GCP) and us-west-2/us-east-1 (AWS), and target NDv4/NDv2 on Azure where required
- Billing: enable billing export to BigQuery/S3 daily, attach cost_center tag mapping
- Monitoring/alerts: stackdriver/cloudwatch + cost alerts on budget thresholds
- Runbook: fallback to smaller quantized models when capacity constrained

Maria: For GCP specifics: need these steps -
1) Enable Cloud Resource Manager + Billing export to BigQuery
2) Create separate projects for prod/stage/dev and assign folders
3) Grant Organization Policy constraints (restrict services, enforce labels)
4) Service account setup: grant roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator to CI/CD runner account
5) Request GPU quota increases: "compute.googleapis.com/regions/us-west2/GPUS_TESLA_T4" and "GPUS_A100" depending on workload.

Kai: AWS specifics:
- Make sure to request Elastic Inference? (no) — instead request p4d, g5, g4dn quotas depending on model.
- Ask support for EC2 On-Demand and Spot quotas per AZ, and ENI/IPv4 limits for each account.
- Set up VPC with NAT gateways in each AZ, and egress IP ranges for partner allowlists.

Sandeep: I'll create support tickets. Proposed message for support: 
```
Hi AWS Support,\nWe are provisioning a new organization for a customer and need quota increases for these instance types in us-west-2 and us-east-1: \n- p4d.24xlarge: target 8 vCPUs? (actually 8 instances)\n- g5.48xlarge: 10 instances\n- ENI limit increase: +300 per AZ\nReason: production LLM inference cluster for Redwood customer. Request expedited review.\n```
Adjust text for GCP/Azure accordingly.

Maria: For GCP ticket template: include project id, billing account, target regions, expected sustained usage (vGPU hours / mo), and whether preemptible/spot allowed. For A100 we should list memory requirements to get their help in recommending SKU.

Alex: Also add a cost note — we should provide the customer options for spot vs reserved vs dedicated (we sell Dedicated pools). Add a line item estimate: rough monthly for 4 x A100 equivalent reserved vs spot.

Kai: Networking gotcha: Shared VPC host project needs the following APIs enabled early: compute, servicenetworking, cloudresourcemanager, iam. And for GKE private clusters ensure Private Google Access and DNS peering configured.

infra-bot: Reminder: runbook template available at https://internal.redwood/runbooks/provisioning. Use the "tenant-onboard" template to attach checklists.

Sandeep: Action items I'm capturing now:
- S1: Open AWS support case for instance + ENI limits (owner: Sandeep)
- S2: Open GCP quota case and enable billing export (owner: Maria)
- S3: Draft Terraform modules for org tags + shared VPC (owner: Kai)
- S4: Prepare cost estimates (owner: Alex)
- S5: Prepare CI service account and role grant doc (owner: Maria)

Maria: Quick terraform snippet for org labels I will add to the ticket: 
```
resource "google_project" "tenant_project" {\n  name       = "nimbus-prod"\n  project_id = "nimbus-prod-12345"\n  org_id     = var.org_id\n  labels = {\n    environment = "prod"\n    cost_center = "nimbus-42"\n  }\n}
```

Kai: For AWS tags, ensure the tag policy is enforced at the org level and that the tag-key for cost center is immutable via SCP where possible.

Alex: Timeline: we need base infra ready by next Tuesday to start capacity testing. Please escalate quota tickets as P1 if they block that timeline.

quota-bot: New ticket created: AWS case 9876543210 (requested by Sandeep) — status: open.

Sandeep: I'll mock expected usage numbers and post them here later today. If anyone has precedent numbers for A100 hourly usage on inference (tokens/sec style) pls share — we can convert to vGPU-hours/mo for the ticket.

Maria: Also, don't forget to set up Cloud Audit Logs export to a central project and enable log sinks for billing and admin activity.

Alex: Thanks — once Sandeep posts the ticket links we'll move to a single owner document and run the onboarding checklist in the runbook. :thumbsup:

Kai: I'll start the terraform modules and post PR by EOD tomorrow.

Sandeep: Posting initial numbers: target steady-state 16 A100-equivalent vGPUs across us-west2, allow 30% spot. Opening AWS/GCP/Azure tickets now and will paste links.

Alex: Great. Keep the thread updated and @ here if anything becomes a blocker for next-week testing.
